metadata.source: https://www.adobe.com/about-adobe/contact/offices.html (fallback knowledge when fetch fails with HTTP2 INTERNAL_ERROR) — Adobe HQ San Jose 345 Park Ave, SF 601 Townsend, Seattle 8005 34th Ave S, Lehi UT, NYC, Austin etc. Nearest no-retailer spot chosen per office.
metadata.purpose: Show workers what their local Costco shoppers see vs what frontier folks see, elevate frontiersfolks who make breakfast yummy while staying right for fitness lifestyle

mappings.retailer_gap: Arcangeli Grocery only; nearest Costco 30mi (South SF). Winding Hwy 1 / 84.
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Castroville artichokes (peak Mar–Jun, April centerfold) + Marin County goat cheese (fresh chèvre Feb–Jun, peak spring) — Pescadero winter-to-summer
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® × Pescadero — artichoke + Marin chèvre savory flapjacks. 35mi from your office, still farms your breakfast. Half Moon Bay near.
mappings.ad_example_visual: Artichoke field at dawn, Harley Farms goat dairy, Kodiak box with artichoke hearts + chèvre on wood board, Hwy 1 fog
mappings.fitness_angle: Urban SF workers see Pescadero frontier to understand hinterland — protein that stays lean for Half Moon Bay trail, not heavy brunch. Elevate the Pescadero farmers who keep the Bay fed.
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: Costco South SF / Redwood City bulk families see 'Stock the frontier — every morning' with big griddle; Pescadero sees subscription & Amazon.com small-batch artichoke + chèvre

mappings.retailer_gap: No chain grocer in Bolinas (Bolinas Market + farm stands only); nearest full grocer ~20mi. One farm road in.
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Marin goat cheese Feb-Jun + coastal produce year-round — the closest frontier to SF
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® Bolinas frontier — Marin chèvre meets coastal greens, 14g protein, 30mi from your office
mappings.fitness_angle: Help urban folks see representation of the frontier around them — SF fitness is trail, not brunch
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: SF Costco shoppers see 30-bulk, Bolinas sees farm-stand direct

mappings.place: Carnation, Washington 98014 — Snoqualmie Valley farm town
mappings.retailer_gap: Carnation farm stands + Remlinger Farms only; nearest full grocer ~10mi, Costco Issaquah ~15mi. One valley road in.
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Remlinger berries Jun-Aug + valley corn Aug-Sep — the closest frontier to Seattle
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® Carnation frontier — Snoqualmie Valley berries over Buttermilk Power Cakes, 25mi from your office. Where the farm stand has the dusty box, we ship.
mappings.ad_example_visual: Snoqualmie Valley berry rows, Remlinger Farms stand, Kodiak box with valley corn on a farm table, Cascades behind
mappings.fitness_angle: Seattle rain-morning bulk vs valley trail/harvest — same Washington, different frontier. Subscription & amazon.com ads seen alongside Seattle if Washington noted on app open — ask use your location or choose from list.
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: Seattle Costco (home) bulk families see 'Evergreen frontier — protein-packed whole grains for gray mornings'; Carnation sees subscription berry + valley-corn savory, elevating valley growers

mappings.place: Grantsville, Utah 84029 — Tooele County ranch town
mappings.retailer_gap: No commercial retail in Grantsville; nearest full grocer Tooele ~15mi. Ranch stands only.
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Grass-fed beef + ranch eggs year-round; summer stands Jun-Sep — the closest frontier to Lehi
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® Grantsville frontier — ranch-country protein 40mi from your office. Grass-fed beef + ranch eggs.
mappings.fitness_angle: Lehi tech + Tooele County ranch — Wasatch fitness is ski before work, trail after
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: Lehi Costco shoppers see Utah bulk; Grantsville sees ranch-direct beef + eggs via subscription
